sendEmail.description: If `true` send email to the registrant. Default: `true`.

jobTitle.description: The registrant's job title. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

companyName.description: The registrant's company. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

address1.description: The registrant's first address line. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

address2.description: The registrant's second address line. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

city.description: The registrant's city name. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

state.description: The registrant's state. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

zipCode.description: The registrant's postal code. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

countryRegion.description: The America is not a country or a specific region. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

workPhone.description: The registrant's work phone number. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

fax.description: The registrant's FAX number. Registration options define whether or not this is required.

customizedQuestions.description: The registrant's answers for customized questions. Registration options define whether or not this is required.
